## Walkthrough The overlap-checking logic in `OverlapOtherIntervalsPathologicalEventMatcher.Allows` now reads `firstTimestamp` from message annotations, parses it as RFC3339, and uses it as the event start time if valid. This extends the effective interval earlier than `i.From`. A fallback to `i.From` occurs if parsing fails or the annotation is absent. A new test validates this behavior across three scenarios. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Overlap Matcher Logic Update**
`pkg/monitortestlibrary/pathologicaleventlibrary/duplicated_event_patterns.go`|Modified `OverlapOtherIntervalsPathologicalEventMatcher.Allows` to compute `eventFrom` by parsing `firstTimestamp` from `i.Message.Annotations` as RFC3339 when present; uses parsed time or falls back to `i.From`. Changes overlap condition from `nui.From.Before(i.From)` to `nui.From.Before(eventFrom)`.| |**Overlap Matcher Test**
`pkg/monitortestlibrary/pathologicaleventlibrary/duplicated_events_special_test.go`|Added `Test_OverlapMatcherUsesFirstTimestamp` with three scenarios: validates `Allows` returns `true` when `firstTimestamp` is within `allowIfWithinIntervals`; returns `false` when interval ends before pathological interval's `To`; falls back to `From` when `firstTimestamp` annotation is absent. Updated imports to include `fmt`, `regexp`, `time`, and `v1`.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~12 minutes

The required threshold is 80.00%. | Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold. |
✅ Passed checks (9 passed) | Check name | Status | Explanation | | :----------------------------------------------: | :------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Description Check | ✅ Passed | Check skipped - CodeRabbit’s high-level summary is enabled. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title directly reflects the main change: modifying overlap-matching logic to honor the firstTimestamp annotation when computing eventFrom in the pathological event matcher. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | The pull request adds only standard Go test functions using Test_* naming and *testing.T, not Ginkgo-based tests. Test names and assertion messages are all static and deterministic with no dynamic values. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | The custom check assesses Ginkgo test code, but the PR contains standard Go unit tests using testing package and testify assertions, making the check non-applicable. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The new tests are standard Go unit tests using the testing package, not Ginkgo e2e tests. Since no Ginkgo e2e tests were added, the check is not applicable. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The new test added is a standard Go unit test using the testing package and testify/assert, not a Ginkgo e2e test, so the SNO compatibility check does not apply. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Changes are limited to test monitoring library code with no deployment manifests, operator code, or scheduling constraints introduced. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | No process-level code entry points were added or modified. fmt package usage limited to string/error creation. Test file properly isolated. Code uses logrus for logging which doesn't write to stdout by default. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The pull request does not add any Ginkgo e2e tests. Changes are limited to standard Go unit tests using the testing package, not Ginkgo's BDD framework. |
